Digital Pinball - Necronomicon.name: Digital Pinball: Necronomicon
Digital Pinball - Necronomicon.summary: Digital Pinball: Necronomicon is a pinball video game created for the Sega Saturn by KaZe in 1996. Only released in Japan, this high-resolution 2D game draws much of its graphical and audio inspiration from the metafictional Necronomicon.

Eternal Melody.name: Eternal Melody
Eternal Melody.summary: Eternal Melody is a simulation game developed by Starlight Marry and published by Media Works for the Sega Saturn.
